descriptionhome: A multiverse fighting game that brings together nearly 200 iconic characters from anime in thrilling battles. With vibrant graphics, faithful special moves, and dynamic gameplay, assemble teams of your favorite heroes and villains to face epic challenges—in story mode or competitive fights.
styledescription: Different fighter types to match your playstyle:
stylemartialartistDesc: Close-combat specialist with fast strikes and devastating combos.
styleswordsmanDesc: Masters the blade with precision and superior reach.
stylemageDesc: Channels arcane power at range to control the pace of battle.
stylemagicfistDesc: Blends magic and martial arts into an explosive hybrid style.
mode1v1Desc: Face your opponent head-on. No excuses—pure skill only.
modeRankedDesc: Climb the global ladder and prove you're the best fighter in the world.
modeKingDesc: Be the last one standing and claim the title of Arena King.
modeTrainingDesc: Sharpen your techniques and combos in unlimited training mode.
modeSurvivalDesc: Face endless waves of enemies and see how far you can go.
downloadtext: Anime Heroes Allstar Clash is available on Windows. Download now and start your adventures in the Anime Multiverse!
communitySubtitle: Connect with millions of players around the world.
faqtext: We know you have questions too.
question1: Is the game free to download?
answer1: Yes, it's free to download and play. We offer an optional contribution for anyone who wants to support the project.
question2: Can I use the same save on different devices?
answer2: Just copy the saves folder from the game's root directory.
question3: Is there a community for the game?
answer3: Yes, our official community is on Discord. Access it via the social buttons at the bottom of the page.
question4: Are the characters your original creations?
answer4: No. All characters were reprogrammed for improvements and balance, each with proper credit.
footerTagline: The ultimate anime fighting game. Enter the arena and prove your worth.
characterguidetext: There are several types of unlockable characters.
commoncharacterdescription: Main roster characters, mostly balanced and allowed in competitive matches. Many are already unlocked.
extracharacterdescription: Characters outside the anime roster to enrich the experience; also allowed in competitive matches.
eliteharacterdescription: Stronger-than-normal boss-tier characters for challenges or fun—not allowed in competitive matches.
unlockablecharacterstext: See how to unlock each character below:
trailerNoConfig: No trailer configured in the panel. Add a YouTube link under Panel → Download & trailer.
textretro: Explore this imaginary world through stunning graphics and dive into fantastic emotions.
textupdates: With every update we improve the player experience and keep adventures running smoothly.
textfeauteres: Make your journey more fun by adding new features to your unique playstyle.
uniqueExperiencetext: A universe where powers and abilities stay true to the original characters.
unlocksystemtext: Beat arcade survival with specific characters to unlock more fighters and stages.
secretstransformstext: Some characters transform only when certain conditions are met.
